g6-math-1.title: Understanding the price list
g6-math-1.body:
Small prices (Nakfa): Margarita 20, Africana 23, Napolitani 24, Hawaii 25, Calzone 26.

Example: Margarita + two drinks (4 each) = 28 Nakfa.

g6-math-1.title: Calculating total costs
g6-math-1.body:
Three small Calzone: 3 × 26 = 78.
Family Calzone: 62.50.
Difference: 15.50 Nakfa.
